name: dkit-monorepo
description: Install Directus modules — schema, permissions, flows, and frontend code you own

scripts.directus:reset: docker compose -f docker/directus/compose.yaml down -v && docker compose -f docker/directus/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.example:next:setup: pnpm --filter dkit build && pnpm --filter @dkit/example-next exec node ../../packages/cli/dist/bin.js init --url ${DIRECTUS_URL:-http://localhost:8055} --token ${DIRECTUS_TOKEN:?set DIRECTUS_TOKEN} && pnpm --filter @dkit/example-next dkit:add-blog
scripts.example:nuxt:setup: pnpm --filter dkit build && pnpm --filter @dkit/example-nuxt exec node ../../packages/cli/dist/bin.js init --framework nuxt --url ${DIRECTUS_URL:-http://localhost:8055} --token ${DIRECTUS_TOKEN:?set DIRECTUS_TOKEN} && pnpm --filter @dkit/example-nuxt dkit:add-blog
